## Grids - 0.01 Longitude x 0.01 Latitude

```{r Construct a 0.01 x 0.01 decimal degree grid}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show code"

# Filter county data set to Manhattan
manhattan_county_4326 <- census_county %>%
  filter(STATEFP == "36" & COUNTYFP == "061") %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(4326)) # This one's in meters

# 3. Create the grid
# cellsize is in the units of the CRS (meters)
grid_01 <- st_make_grid(manhattan_county_4326, cellsize = c(0.01, 0.01), square = TRUE)

# 4. Convert grid to sf object and crop it to the island's shape
grid_01_sf <- st_sf(grid_01)
manhattan_custom_01_grid <- st_intersection(grid_01_sf, manhattan_county_4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(census_county)) # Transform back to line up with leaflet

# Plot
leaflet(manhattan_custom_01_grid) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(weight = 0.5, opacity = 1.0)
```

::: {.notes}
- Go by decimal degrees
- Nice because you can just trucate your coordinates to a certain number of decimals
:::
